pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Individual dark regions on the flank exhibit varied aspect ratios with higher spatial area than those on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan pathways forming a topological graph with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. Corridor thickness is non-uniform, appearing narrower on the neck and widening across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a dark, fibrous 1D silhouette with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background along the upper neck and shoulder.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized dark, hyper-pigmented focal region is visible on the upper dorsal flank, displaying textural disruption compared to the surrounding pelage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark, circular textural anomaly is present on the upper mid-flank, appearing as a concentrated disruption of the patch pattern.
